selection: Shortlisted after exploratory exact screens; independent physical rerun, unchanged comparison methods. Seed0 only.
correction: v1 rejected while constructing an unused proxy-objective factory, before any update. Retain original factory for unused objectives and supply two live RNG adapters expected by the original seed-offset wrapper. No training rule changes.
transport: Original parallel AirComp, all-head optimizer, FU-relative distortion guard,0.1J network RF cap and0.32W device cap. Charge all executed new gradient/teacher work using original accounting.

screen_protocol.purpose: Find a common setting that improves fixed-reference forget KL while maintaining current retained mR leadership on both datasets. No guaranteed rank, no baseline modification, all outcomes exported.
screen_protocol.screen: Fresh warm20 to200 FL runs, same45 requests/225 prescribed FU cycles and original schedule, exact aggregation. Faster diagnosis only; no physical feasibility/energy/delay claim. The control must reproduce the previous exact-P-KS final tensor.
screen_protocol.search: 21 predeclared settings shared between datasets. Development evaluation reuses already-inspected seed0 cohorts; not independent test confirmation. Do not select a different setting for each dataset.
screen_protocol.FL: Current half-random/half-cached-training-loss priority sampler; optional batch32. Bound variants also compute uniform16 gradient and constrain the priority-minus-uniform contribution to rho times its norm. Late-uniform schedules change the sampler at a declared round. Extra executed operations counted, never borrowed reference gradients.
screen_protocol.FU: 3*relu(local forget proxy-KL - threshold) + retention*retainedCE + consistency*request-start-teacher KL. Optional projection removes the preservation-gradient component opposing the forgetting gradient. Optional stop zeros the entire FU update when its local proxy constraint is satisfied. Zero updates still charge executed work; completed prescribed cycles do not certify deletion.
screen_protocol.teachers: Only original known-cohort retained-only proxy20 and request-start teacher. Reference200, validation queries and evaluation probabilities never enter training. Pre-existing future-forget-cohort assumption is unchanged.
screen_protocol.scope: Same frozen encoders/adapters and temperature. All deleted videos/native captions. Primary common reference200 stays unchanged. Policy-matched references, if needed for shortlisted settings, are evaluation-only and accompany common KL.
screen_protocol.qualification: Primary success requires retained mR >= original P-KS on both datasets AND common mean and worst-request KL better than all three unmodified comparators. Also report weaker tradeoff outcomes; failure to qualify is an explicit result.
